headline: Chelsea dominate but Stamford Bridge stays goalless at half-time
paragraphs: Chelsea have been the busier side at Stamford Bridge, and the home crowd has had plenty to cheer about. Nicolas Jackson had three big chances, in the 6th, 13th and 18th minutes, and Moisés Caicedo had one in the 8th. None of them found the net, and the score is still 0-0 at the break.

Chelsea had 59% of the ball and completed 87% of their passes. They fired 9 shots, with 5 on target. West Ham managed just 2 shots, with 1 on target, and struggled to get out of their own half for long spells. Noni Madueke was sharp, completing 95% of his passes and winning 9 duels, while Malo Gusto won 39 duels across the pitch.
West Ham will be hoping for a better second half, but Chelsea look like the side most likely to break the deadlock. Stay with us for the restart.
